mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending confidence and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO below 95), declining industrial production signals production bottlenecks and inflationary pressures, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% annualized) reflects robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting immediate market expectations of tighter monetary policy that drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through wage growth and elevated consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 100) reflects expanding manufacturing capacity and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate outlooks and supply chain efficiency.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
